newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA CONSIDERING NEW VENUES FOR ALBANIA MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA CONSIDERING NEW VENUES FOR ALBANIA MATCHES.

text.p: FIFA said on Tuesday it was looking into the possibility of alternative venues for two World Cup qualifying matches involving Albania because of the worsening violence in the country.

Albania is scheduled to host Ukraine in a group nine qualifying match on March 29 and Germany four days later but with the country teetering on the brink of civil war it may be forced to play both matches at a neutral site.
The FIFA World Cup organising committee is to discuss the situation and make a decision before the end of the week, a spokesman said.
"It's become clear that it's not possible to play matches there," said FIFA spokesman Keith Cooper. "We have two options.
"We can postpone the games but there is no certainty that the situation will settle down. The other option is to play on the same dates at neutral grounds.
"The question is where would those venues be?"
